preamble.detail: Welcome to the PilotFish demo: CSV FTP To SQL. Poll a CSV file from an FTP directory, stage it locally, parse rows (CSV→XML Dialect A), and insert into SQL Server dbo.CsvPatients. PilotFish supports the whole flow out of the box.
